title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 - I. Allegro con brio
performer: Fulda Symphonic Orchestra, Simon Schindler, conductor (Orangerie Fulda, 2002)
format: Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz, stereo, about 160 kbps
license: EFF Open Audio License 1.0 (attribution and share-alike, like CC-BY-SA); the composition is public domain. Original source: http://www-plan.cs.colorado.edu/henkel/fso/index-en.html
notes: Complete first movement, including the exposition repeat.

excerpt.notes: The opening motto (G-G-G-Eb, F-F-F-D) from silence, then the recapitulation and coda. The join is in the near-silence as the second fermata dies away, where exposition and recapitulation continue with the same C minor theme (they align at a steady 255.1 s offset). The recapitulation's own motto is smeared by the hammered lead-in, so it is skipped. Keeps the oboe cadenza and ends on the real ending.
